eligibility_reason: Reanalysis of the same data: the paper re-runs Cairns and Davis (1998)'s regressions on their own 28-gold-mine cross-section ('a replication of that study using the same data'; 'Using their data, I show...') and re-estimates them with robust/WLS methods. No new data are collected, so it falls in the codebook's 'reanalysis or reproducibility check of the same data' negative genre.
why_negative: Reanalysis/reproducibility check of the same data (Cairns & Davis 1998 gold-mine dataset); no new data.

ling26:10.1007--s00181-005-0242-z#ling26.reason: Not a qualifying replication: the paper reanalyses Cairns & Davis's own data ('a replication of that study using the same data', abstract; 'Using their data, I show...', Introduction). The codebook requires new data; same-data reanalysis is a listed negative genre.
